description.value: The Carvery Sandwich Shop is a craft sandwich and soup counter in South Surrey helmed by Red Seal chef Bryan Mendiola, whose globe-spanning culinary background informs a rotating menu of fusion-style handcrafted sandwiches — from a Cubano pressed on Cuban loaf to a Lambwich Panini with chimichurri. Meats are seasoned, marinated, and roasted in-house with no fillers or preservatives, and the shop is locally noted for its rotating house-made chowders and soups. Online ordering is available through the shop's own app, and the venue also offers catering and after-hours facility rental for groups up to 40.

address.value: Unit 102, 2430 King George Blvd, Surrey, BC V4P 1H5
